title: Super Bowl XLIX
overview: Super Bowl XLIX, played on February 1, 2015, at University of Phoenix Stadium in Glendale, Arizona, saw the New England Patriots defeat the Seattle Seahawks 28-24 in one of the most dramatic finishes in Super Bowl history. The win gave the Patriots their fourth Super Bowl title under head coach Bill Belichick and quarterback Tom Brady, ending a decade-long championship drought and reigniting a dynasty that had defined the early 2000s.
